IMP PROBUS P F AVG ; CONCORD MIL (IT)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper, silver washed radiate or billon antoninianus of Probus (276-282AD). Obverse: Radiate wearing Imperial mantle bust left holding eagle tipped sceptre. Inscription: IMP PROBUS P F AVG Reverse: Emperor standing right clasping right hand with Concordia standing left. Inscription: CONCORD MIL (IT). Mint mark: PXX[I]. Mint name: Ticinum (Italy). Reece period 14. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in very fine condition with little wear but 'nibbled' around the edges by corrosion. The coin is likely to date to 276-282AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 59, Roman Coins and their Values III, David R. Sear, Spink 2005, page 472 no. 11967…
